title: Homogeneity of random restriction expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta,c\in\mathbb R$, and let $g$ be any real-valued function of a free-coordinate subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and signs on its complement. The random restriction expectation of $c$ times $g$ is $c$ times the random restriction expectation of $g$.
hypotheses_covered: Function $g$ on a free-coordinate subset and signs on its complement
